goal: Find SSH auth events on web-2 around 2026-07-26T20:06:42Z — did the attempt succeed or fail, what auth method (password/publickey/cert), what source user, and what destination host?
what_to_summarize: sshd Accepted or Failed events on web-2 in the ±15m window around 2026-07-26T20:06:42Z
auth method (password vs publickey vs certificate) extracted from the message field
destination host (db-1) and source IP if visible
user name (dev.dana) in the auth events
any other SSH-related events on web-2 in the window

params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:51:42Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:21:42Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted   = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed     = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                              message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other"),
           source.ip, host.name, user.name
| SORT accepted DESC, failed DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:51:42Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:21:42Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY event.action, event.outcome, message
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 20

params.query:

        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)

           host.name

goal: Find ALL sshd events on web-2 between 20:05:00Z and 20:15:00Z on 2026-07-26, including any 'Accepted' events for any user. Also check if the v2-sshd-success-after-failures alerts reference specific accepted events — search for message field containing 'Accepted' on web-2 in this window.
what_to_summarize: all sshd events (Accepted, Failed, pam_unix) on web-2 from 20:05 to 20:15 on 2026-07-26
any message containing 'Accepted' on web-2 in this window — regardless of user.name field parsing
user names in any Accepted events found
source IPs in any Accepted events found
exact count and timestamps of all events in this 10-minute window

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T20:05:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:15:00Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND (process.name == "sshd" OR message LIKE "*sshd*" OR message LIKE "*Accepted*" OR message LIKE "*Failed password*" OR message LIKE "*pam_unix*" OR message LIKE "*session*")
| STATS event_count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY event_type = CASE(message LIKE "*Accepted*", "Accepted",
                             message LIKE "*Failed password*", "Failed",
                             message LIKE "*pam_unix*", "pam_unix",
                             message LIKE "*session*", "session",
                             "other")
| SORT event_count DESC
